project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + PostgreSQL + Prisma ORM
build_system: npm with Next.js build system, Prisma for database, tsx for scripts
test_framework: vitest for unit tests, vitest with integration config for integration tests
test_command: npm run test && npm run test:integration
verification_instructions: Run npm run verify which executes: prisma generate → tsc --noEmit → next lint → vitest run → next build. All must pass clean.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that require committing. Prisma generates @prisma/client to node_modules (gitignored). Next.js generates .next/ build output (gitignored).
environment_constraints: PostgreSQL database required (local or Docker). Never commit .env files. Rate limiting uses in-memory LRU cache (production should use Redis). Telephony integration with Exotel is optional and requires env vars. Email delivery not yet configured (password resets log to console in dev).
contribution_requirements: README states code has never been run/built. First build will have errors. Follow verification order: typecheck → lint → tests → build. Fix compile errors first. All authentication, permissions, and audit logging are implemented. Seed creates dev accounts only - never in production.

key_patterns.server_actions: app/actions/*.ts use 'use server', return FormState, revalidatePath after mutations
key_patterns.auth_pattern: requireUser() and requirePagePermission() from lib/auth/session.ts, assertCan() in services, server-only directive on all service files
key_patterns.error_handling: AppError extends Error with code+message, caught in actions with fail() helper that console.errors then returns user message
key_patterns.rate_limiting: lib/rate-limit.ts exports rateLimit() factory returning { check(limit, token) } - current signature mismatch with usage in auth actions
key_patterns.database_access: All via Prisma from lib/db.ts, services own business logic, actions are thin adapters
key_patterns.validation: Zod schemas in validations/*.ts, services call .safeParse() or .parse()
key_patterns.scope_enforcement: services/scope-service.ts and lib/auth/scope.ts build Prisma where clauses based on user role, applied in all list/get operations

directory_structure: app/(admin|app|auth|telecaller)/ - Next.js route groups by role/feature. app/actions/ - server actions. app/api/ - API routes (webhooks, exports, health). services/ - business logic layer (server-only). lib/ - utilities, auth, validation, domain logic. features/ - client components by feature. components/ui/ - reusable UI components. components/layout/ - app shell. prisma/ - schema, migrations, seeds. tests/ - vitest unit & integration tests. docs/ - comprehensive markdown docs per phase.
